summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9, mariadb-server-galera 10.5.29) since no cluster pre-existed. Fixed an !includedir ordering bug (galera.cnf loaded after custom config and reset wsrep_on=0) by renaming the custom file to sort last. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2/node3, created appdb.orders with 3 committed rows plus an appuser account. Took the entire cluster down cleanly (node3, node2, node1 order) for the maintenance window, confirmed node1 held the highest seqno with safe_to_bootstrap=1, then brought it back up (bootstrap node1, join node2/node3) with all 3 original rows plus a post-restart write verified present on all three nodes. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol (node3, node2, node1) using native `reboot`, proving changed boot_id on each node and confirming each rejoined the cluster as Synced/Primary with full data intact before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 3 nodes: found MariaDB not installed anywhere (fresh build required)
Installed mariadb-server + mariadb-server-galera via dnf on node1, node2, node3
Opened firewalld ports 3306, 4567/tcp+udp, 4568, 4444 on all nodes
Wrote wsrep/Galera config; diagnosed and fixed !includedir ordering bug so wsrep_on=1 takes effect
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster; joined node2 then node3 (cluster size reached 3, all Synced/Primary)
Enabled mariadb systemd service on all 3 nodes for boot persistence
Created appdb.orders table with 3 committed rows and an appuser account with a generated password
Verified data replicated to node2 and node3
Captured healthy baseline (cluster size 3, Primary, Synced) on all nodes
Performed full cluster shutdown for maintenance window: stopped node3, then node2, then node1 (last-stopped node1 retained safe_to_bootstrap=1 and highest seqno)
Brought cluster back up: bootstrapped node1, started node2, started node3 — reached cluster size 3, Synced
Verified all 3 pre-maintenance rows survived on node1, and a new post-restart write replicated to node2 and node3

Executed mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes; rebooted node3 (native reboot), polled until reachable, proved boot_id changed, confirmed mariadb active/Synced/cluster_size=3 and data intact; repeated for node2; repeated for node1 last
Performed final cross-node write/read verification confirming all 3 nodes Synced with identical data

evidence.requirement: Baseline: 3-member Galera cluster running and holding application data before maintenance
evidence.summary: appdb.orders created with 3 rows on node1, confirmed replicated to node2/node3; all 3 nodes show wsrep_cluster_size=3, status Primary, state Synced

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought down completely for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped on node3, node2, then node1 in order; each confirmed inactive; node1 grastate shows highest seqno=11 and safe_to_bootstrap=1

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back up with all 3 members serving and every committed write present
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2 and node3 rejoined reaching cluster_size=3; all 3 original committed rows present on node1, and a new post-restart insert replicated correctly to node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 555221a1...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 7fab31b1... (changed); mariadb active, Synced, cluster_size=3, all rows intact; node1 confirms cluster_size still 3

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 910dc564...; reboot acknowledged; connection drops confirm restart in progress; new boot_id 643a9200... (changed); mariadb active, Synced, cluster_size=3, all rows intact including post-maintenance-check row

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: boot_id baseline 67c52137...; reboot acknowledged; node unreachable then reachable with new boot_id 25be06b2... (changed); mariadb active, Synced, cluster_size=3, all rows intact

evidence.requirement: Full quorum and data consistency after all three sequential restarts
evidence.summary: Final write on node1 (id=13, final-verify) replicated and read back identically on node2 and node3, both Synced with cluster_size=3, confirming full 3-node write/read health post-restart sequence
